messages:
Ana: Quick sync 99we need a terse relnotes line for the next docs deploy about the embed API cleanup. Aim: 1 bullet + migration link + tiny examples.

Marco: Draft bullet idea: 'Streaming embeddings removed; migrate to embeddings.v2 or use non-streaming calls. See migration guide.' too blunt?

Priya: Good. Add a who-cares line: 'Teams using streaming embeddings or SDKs <0.7.0.' And a known-issue note: 'Older streaming clients may see truncated payloads (400). Update to >=0.7.0.'

Jin (SDK): I'll update JS snippet. Keep examples <=5 lines. Example: 
```
import { Embeddings } from '@redwood/inference'
const e = new Embeddings()
await e.create({ input: ['a','b'], model: 'embed-v2' })
```

Ana: Nice. Also add a 1-line normalizing hint: `input = [s.strip().lower() for s in texts]`. And a cache-key suggestion.

Marco: Found a dead link in the migration guide (/docs/streams-old#faq). I'll replace to /docs/migrations/embeds-v2#faq in PR.

SDK-Bot: PR 6112 opened for migration doc and snippets by @jin.

QA: We'll validate example outputs and provide console screenshot by tomorrow noon.

Priya: Target merge EOD tomorrow; once merged I'll paste final bullets into the relnotes doc and notify comms. Keep microcopy suggestions here.

Ana: Small copy nit: use phrase 'streaming embeddings' consistently.

Marco: Updated PR and fixed link. PR: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/6112

Jin (SDK): Thanks all, will bump SDK changelog after merge.

Ana: Checklist: [x] relnotes bullet draft, [x] migration guide PR, [~] screenshots, [x] SDK snippet. Good work.
